prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit image 1, the finished cover illustration for A Break for Kit. Images 2–3 are identity/prop references only. Keep exactly the current characters, facial expressions, poses, truck, block COUNT and block positions relative to one another, furniture and story state. Make these precise production fixes: (1) remove ALL grain/noise/speckling and simulated rug, wood or paper texture from the ENTIRE image. Render the rug as solid flat green with at most one smooth hard-edged shadow shape, the wall/floor as flat colors, and wood as simple flat color shapes. Keep clean continuous dark outlines, with restrained smooth cel shading only, not gradients or textured paint. (2) Widen the camera slightly to put the COMPLETE Kit, Zoe, their feet and hands, all blocks, the red truck and wooden chair at least 8% of image width/height away from every edge. Extend the existing classroom naturally into the margins; no border or blank inset frame. Do not crop, remove or add any story object. Preserve the exact composition relationships and subject sizes relative to each other, just fit them more safely within the same landscape 3:2 frame. No text, no labels, no extra limbs, no extra blocks. The unchanged exact scene specification is:
Use case: illustration-story. One finished landscape 3:2 full-bleed picture-book illustration, one coherent scene and moment, no panels or contact sheet. Bold clean clear 2D children's cartoon throughout, crisp continuous dark outlines, flat clean colors, restrained smooth cel shading, no painted or grainy texture, no gouache, no embossed relief, no 3D. Original friendly readable illustration. Ordinary neutral settings; no flags, religious/political symbols or costumes. No logos, text, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, captions, watermarks or page borders. Natural anatomy and coherent hand/prop contact. Essential content at least 8 percent inside every edge.
WD-KIT / Kit: six-year-old human boy, golden light-medium skin, short straight black side-parted hair, teal T-shirt, mustard shorts, navy sneakers. WD-ZOE / Zoe: six-year-old human girl, deep brown skin, black hair in two puffs, yellow T-shirt, plum overalls, white sneakers. Kit and Zoe have equal standing height. Include only characters needed by this exact scene, not every reference pose. Preserve exact reference identity and clothing.
Book: A Break for Kit; World Discovery; fiction.
Setting: Ordinary classroom floor in daylight; low block road crosses a green rug; one low wooden seat beside the rug. Kit and Zoe retain the locked cast clothing.
Design locks for the book's recurring subjects/props (NOT a visibility list; never insert later objects/states prematurely): Eight large tan rectangular blocks forming one road; One small red toy truck; One low wooden seat; One green rug
 Input references lock identity, prop design and location; compose a NEW image for the exact scene, never reproduce the reference-board layout. The reference and overall prop list may contain finished objects and later story events: these are DESIGN REFERENCES ONLY, not permission to show them now. Show only the people, objects and development stage required below.
Dedicated cover art: Kit sits comfortably on the low seat beside an almost complete block road. His red truck rests on the rug; Zoe kneels by the far end. Emphasize his deliberate pause, not illness, collapse or adult permission.
Do not add later events, duplicate props or a separate inset. No written title; the app renders live text.
Composition/count clarification: Show exactly eight tan blocks in total: seven blocks in the incomplete road and ONE loose block beside its single block-sized gap; no blocks in hands. Kit is seated on the wooden chair with a backrest. The road has six blocks in one straight connected segment, then a one-block-sized gap, then the seventh block turning perpendicular at its far end. Zoe kneels at this far end. The red truck is beside Kit at the near end. Only one truck and chair.
